generator_rule: For each fixed seed, random.Random(seed), row-major choice from ascending ranks1..10 excluding placed left/up ranks; then randint(1,10) at(0,1), then independently at(10,14). Keep all16 outputs.
primary_quality_eligibility: Every board/query/arm in a stream source-valid and policy-evaluable with true reach/regret identities; each pair completes K or both normally stop NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE at the same actual n<K.
primary_cost_eligibility: Every board/query/arm source-valid; preserve valid no-candidate early stops and policy-unavailable costs.
primary_unit: suffix stream; mean over ten queries per board, then equally over sixteen fixed boards
interval: two-sided95% Student t Monte Carlo interval across eligible streams
independent_query_cost: full board prefix whole_seconds + full current-query preparation whole_seconds + local whole_run_seconds; neither prefix term amortized
incomplete_policy: retain source, actual costs and missing probability; no filling budgets, imputing policy, replacing starts or appending streams
novelty_scope: raw/D4 starting-board or old-target equality only against listed small rosters; no historical descendant audit
evidence_scope: constructed new H2 development starts; conditional on fixed roots and common prefixes; no natural-play distribution or full online algorithm claim
equal_budget_rule: Both completed_fixed_budget with actualn=K, or both NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE with same actualn<K; unequal counts excluded, no padding. Report completed-K and shared early-stop separately.
pre_sampling_protocol_clarification: Before any production prefix or suffix sampling, include matching natural no-candidate stops in equal-actual-budget quality; generator supports such starts. Algorithms and maximum budgets unchanged.
